entity_id.description: Customer identifier (unique ID of the customer)

source_system.description: The system that generated the event

event_time.description: Timestamp when the event actually occurred at the source

source_id.description: Original record ID in the source system

trace_id.description: Distributed tracing ID for the request flow

correlation_id.description: Identifier linking multiple related events together

unit_price.description: Price per single unit of the product

total_amount.description: Final total amount (price * quantity - discount + tax)

merchant_id.description: Identifier for the merchant or seller

store_id.description: Identifier for the physical or online store
